anti_hallucination_rules: Historical roadmap status never proves current runtime status by itself.
Contradictory sources must be logged and resolved by code/test/telemetry or explicit human decision, never by model guess.
No item may disappear between roadmap versions without a changelog status.
Do not collapse legado, Financial Agent v1 and novo agente/ARQ into one system label.
Do not mark a legacy component removable from static search alone; require runtime evidence and applicable observation window.
Do not call an evidence source current after its observation date without revalidation.
Do not infer the root cause of the audio failure from unit tests; distinguish user-reported runtime failure from code-level capability.
